item.text:
It provides order helpers: item total calculation, discount application, average item price, and printable order formatting.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` and throws (`undefined.price`). Use `i < items.length`. [test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:5)
- `averageItemPrice` divides the total order value by item count, not total quantity; its name is ambiguous/wrong for quantity-weighted “average item price.” It also returns `NaN` for an empty array. [test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:18)
